bodyDescription: This delicious jelly treat made with tuna and chicken is a veritable delicacy for every cat!The natural ingredients are carefully steamed so that the nutrients and aromas are preserved. Cleaning and preparing the tuna and chicken, filling the tins and adding toppings are all done manually.  Tuna is easy to digest and contains essential fatty acids to support a shiny coat and healthy skin. Cats are crazy about this jelly taste sensation!
